description:
Facts of the pulse study of agent data-A (Nov 1): every number of the pulse section that comes from the stored
pulses, assembled from pulses_index_A.json (pulses_extract.py), reproduce_A.json (pulses_reproduce.py) and
pulses_stats_A.json, pulses_stats_A_rows.json, closed_*.npz (pulses_stats.py), with the physics checks evaluated by
explicit rules (each check states its rule, its numbers and whether it holds).  Statistics: mean +- sample s.d. (ddof 1)
over all starts of a case, n stated.  Writes manuscript_figures/sims/results/pulses/pulses_facts_A.json.
  bash manuscript_figures/tools/py.sh manuscript_figures/sims/pulses_facts.py
units: amplitudes as fractions of their bounds (r = |Omega|/10g, a_j = |u_j|/g); u_+-, |u_-| in units of g; rotation angle int|Omega|dt in units of pi; times in ns

reproduction.rule: every extracted pulse re-simulated with the routine that produced the stored numbers (traces.run for tracking, flip_gate.evaluate for the flip), cutoff 90, closed and Lindblad; threshold 1e-5

closed_propagator_check.rule: closed propagation of pulses_stats.py (GRAPE models, exact slice unitaries) against stored values

bang_bang.rule: near bang-bang if, on average over the starts, >= 90% of the (slice, branch) amplitudes sit at a bound (a >= 0.999 or a <= 0.001); the same for the qubit drive r
bang_bang.expectation: amplitude-bounded time-optimal control saturates the bounds (Pontryagin), except on singular arcs; the stored pulses are not time optimal (fixed T, tracking or target objective)

conditional_part.rule: sum_j |j><j| (x) G(u_j) = 1 (x) G(u_+) + sigma_z (x) G(u_-); without u_- the qubit and the oscillator never entangle, and by Proposition thm:nogo the oscillator then evolves by a Gaussian unitary; holds if the conditional fraction int|u_-|^2/int(|u_+|^2 + |u_-|^2) is > 0.1 in every start of the tracking and CS cases

entanglement.rule: closed evolution, cutoff 90, slice ends; Tr rho_osc^2 = 1 for a product state and 1/2 for maximal qubit-oscillator entanglement; 'made' if the mean minimum purity < 0.9, 'undone' if the mean final purity > 0.96 (flip: smallest over the inputs 0_L, 1_L, +_L)
entanglement.caveat: the final purity is bounded below by F_T^2 (lambda_max >= F_T), so a high final purity follows from a high closed F_T and is not independent evidence; min over tracking starts of (purity_final - F_T^2) = 1.65e-03

entanglement_ranking_tracking.rule: mean minimum purity over the starts (SNAP: non-trivial starts only, the trivial ones never leave |0>); consistent with the tangential capacity, by which CS can push along the path without entangling and ECD and SNAP cannot (v = 0), but not a proof of it

rotations_vs_conditional_part.rule: slices with r >= 0.5 ('drive on') and |u_-| >= 0.5 g ('conditional on'); a literal interleaving of rotations and conditional gates (SI Sec. V) would put the slices in 'drive only' or 'conditional only' and give a negative correlation of r and |u_-|; 'simultaneous' if both-on exceeds the two alone together

pure_conditional_at_bound.rule: fraction of slices with |u_-| >= 0.99 g, that is u_e = -u_g with both branches at the bound (the ECD gate generator for displacements, the sigma_z-conditional squeeze for CS)

ecd_flip_stall.rule: ECD gate-only flip pulses with score < 0.8 (the stall near the best plain displacement): smallest purity over the three inputs and conditional fraction, against the other starts

snap_zero_drive.rule: largest cavity drive |eps|/g over the slices of every trivial run (mfcommon.trivial), and their qubit drive; with the oscillator in |0> the qubit drive and the dispersive term do not act on it

qubit_drive_strength.rule: time-averaged |Omega| (fraction of 10 g) and fraction of slices with |Omega| <= chi_d = g (r <= 0.1); SNAP non-trivial starts only; number-selective qubit rotations need |Omega| <~ chi_d

gate_vs_tracking_824ns.rule: same duration (824 ns), all starts; flip: purity minimum and photon maximum over the inputs

snap_flip_tracking_412ns.rule: observation, not a claim: chi_d int P_e dt is the phase-space rotation angle that the dispersive term imparts on the |e> branch; a quarter turn maps |0_L> to |+_L> (F(0_L -> 1_L) = 1/2) and scores 2/3 against X_L
